title: Shows like Limetown
description: Found recordings, missing communities, and investigative fiction for listeners who want a case file to open.
label: Investigative fiction

showReasons.the-black-tapes: A skeptical documentary investigation builds its paranormal cases through tapes and recorded testimony.
showReasons.shelterwood: A 16-episode docu-horror search for a missing sister uses found footage, interviews, and an impossible suburb as its evidence trail.
showReasons.video-palace: A lost VHS and a media investigation make every clue feel like something the listener has just found.
showReasons.the-lovecraft-investigations: Podcast investigation structure makes each discovery feel like evidence before the wider mythos takes over.
showReasons.archive-81: Archival recordings and occult history make the act of cataloging part of the danger.
showReasons.passenger-list: A vanished plane and widening interviews offer the same investigative pull on a larger, more mobile mystery.
showReasons.the-deca-tapes: Segmented recordings and a locked-room puzzle make the format itself part of the mystery.
